assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: Eluting peptides were analysed on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher) using MS3 SPS with the settings recommended by the instrument manufacturer for TMT11 plex analysis.
labeling: Four microlitres of 22 g l−1 11-plex TMT tags (ThermoFisher A34808) were added to each sample.
TMT6plex was set as fixed modification.
quantification: The quantification results of PSMs were combined into protein-level quantitation using MSstats TMT R package.
enrichment: we performed immunoprecipitation–mass spectrometry in WM3918 cells overexpressing CRKL with a V5 tag
immunoprecipitation was performed in 2-ml deep well plates using 1 mg of protein material and 5.75 μg V5 antibody (Invitrogen R960–25) bound to 5.75 μl Protein G Sepharose

scope: To characterize the protein complex formed by CRKL and identify its binding partners, we performed immunoprecipitation–mass spectrometry in WM3918 cells overexpressing CRKL with a V5 tag
